displayName: Turn a messy email thread into a project brief
summary: Turn any email chain into a clean brief ready to share.

useCases.title: Turn a messy email thread into a project brief
useCases.message: Help me turn an email thread into a clean brief. Ask me which thread to pull from. If you don't already know which email account I use, ask. Then read the full thread, extract key context, decisions, and open questions, and write it up as a brief I can share.
